rule: Frozen BEFORE any Phase 14 final evaluation (morphology-disjoint final templates final_np1/final_np2, IBL sessions T-W, Allen final mice). Selected on dev/select only.
count_rule: two iff F21(ms3, spatial whitening) > per-session self-calibrated thr2 (98th pct of development-morphology singles in the session background); three iff two and F32 > thr3

uncertainty.secondary: profile-likelihood region at q_region; fixed disc r_fixed

primary_hypotheses: tb50 vs counts (SG orientation, SF, DG, NS)
ccf_surface vs counts for Gabor position
cross-mouse zscore area_tb25 vs chance, area permutation and shuffled labels
